data.long_meaning: The name Kaushiki is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kaushika', which means 'golden' or 'shining'. In Hindu mythology, Kaushiki is also the name of the goddess of speech, who is revered for her eloquence and wisdom. This name is believed to bring prosperity, happiness, and success to the bearer. The name Kaushiki carries the meaning “Golden, Shining, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kaushiki usually hope their child will grow to embody golden, shining, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kaushiki belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden, Shining, Radiant.”
